component.name: MCP Client for Ollama
component.summary: Interactive terminal application for connecting local Ollama LLMs to MCP servers

description.p: MCP Client for Ollama (ollmcp) is a modern, interactive terminal application for connecting local Ollama LLMs to one or more Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, enabling advanced tool use and workflow automation.
Features include multi-server support, MCP prompts, agent mode, human-in-the-loop tool execution, advanced model configuration, fuzzy autocomplete, performance metrics, and streaming responses.
